en.intro: Learn how to prepare for cyclones and protect people, homes and communities from dangerous weather.
en.importance_1: Prepare emergency bags with important supplies.
en.importance_2: Store enough food and clean drinking water.
en.importance_3: Protect and secure your home before strong winds arrive.
en.importance_4: Plan where to go if evacuation becomes necessary.
en.importance_5: Listen to weather updates and follow official safety advice.
en.importance_summary: Preparing early helps protect lives and reduce damage to homes.
en.safety_heading: Four Ways to Reduce Cyclone Risks
en.safety_intro: Discover simple actions that can help protect people and communities.
en.house_1: Secure roofs, walls, doors and windows against strong winds.
en.house_2: Repair broken or damaged parts of the house.
en.house_3: Remove loose objects around the house that could fly away.
en.house_summary: Strong and well-maintained houses help protect families and reduce cyclone damage.
en.house_tip: Securing your home before a cyclone can help reduce wind damage.
en.supplies_1: Prepare enough clean drinking water and food.
en.supplies_2: Keep medicine and a first-aid kit ready.
en.supplies_3: Bring a torch, extra batteries and a power bank.
en.supplies_4: Store supplies in a safe and dry place.
en.supplies_5: Keep everything somewhere your family can easily find it.
en.supplies_summary: Prepare an emergency bag before bad weather arrives.
en.drains_1: Throw rubbish into bins instead of leaving it on the streets.
en.drains_2: Keep drains and waterways clear of waste.
en.drains_3: Allow rainwater to flow away easily.
en.drains_4: Prevent water from building up on streets and nearby areas.
en.drains_summary: Clean surroundings help reduce flooding during heavy rainfall.
en.drains_tip: Clean drains allow rainwater to flow away and help reduce flooding.
en.nature_1: Protect existing mangrove forests along coastlines.
en.nature_2: Plant suitable trees and vegetation in coastal areas.
en.nature_3: Mangrove roots help hold soil together and reduce erosion.
en.nature_4: Mangroves can slow waves and reduce some storm impacts.
en.nature_summary: Healthy mangrove forests provide natural protection for coastal communities.
en.mangrove_tip: Mangrove forests provide natural protection for coastal communities.
en.remember_2: Prepare emergency supplies before a cyclone arrives.
en.remember_4: Protect mangroves and the natural environment.
en.remember_5: Follow official weather updates and evacuation instructions.
en.remember_summary: Preparing early can save lives and help communities recover more easily.
